reports.text: Jake Bauers will have No. 18 with the Red Sox. Most recently worn with distinction by Kyle Schwarber (2021), Mitch Moreland (2017-20), and Shane Victorino (2013-15).

While it seemed like an odd fit initially, Craig Breslow said the Red Sox had targeted Jake Bauers as early as June as a player who’d fit their roster. He called Bauers’ agent as soon as free agency opened and officially had Bauers signed 15 days later www.nytimes.com/athletic/779...

Jake Bauers was the Red Sox' top target, and they offered the pomp and circumstance to match. "We feel like Jake puts a pretty sizable dent in the shopping list," Craig Breslow said. www.bostonglobe.com/2026/11/17/s...
Red Sox officially signed Jake Bauers. They opened a 40-man roster spot by trading LHP Raymond Burgos to the Athletics for 23-year-old Double-A RHP Kenya Huggins, a former 4th-round pick of the Reds.
Red Sox officially announce the signing of Jake Bauers. To make room on the 40-man roster, they traded LHP Raymond Burgos to the Athletics in exchange for minor league RHP Kenya Huggins.
